text:
The 2006 award I can best support is the Annie Award for Storyboarding in an Animated Television Production, which an IMDb awards page credits to the episode "The Deserter" (I could not match that to an official Annie Awards list). The Primetime Emmy for Outstanding Voice-Over Performance does not fit: my search found no voice-over Emmy for the series, and the Emmys' listing shows the juried voice-over category awarded nothing in 2007. Sources: [IMDb awards page](https://m.imdb.com/es/name/nm1132209/awards) and [Wikipedia, season 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:_The_Last_Airbender_season_2).

CONFIDENCE: 60
